name: Ramen Rush: The Great Ramen Festival
desc: A fast, cute, single-file arcade game: steer your bowl as Rin, catch the good noodles, dodge the fish, grab power-ups and fill your bowl across 8 festival stages — each with its own flavor and rising difficulty — to win the Golden Ladle. Entirely canvas-drawn: no assets, no build step, no dependencies. Works with keyboard, mouse or touch.
controls: Arrows or A/D, mouse or finger to steer the bowl, Space/Enter to start, skip the intro or pause, P pause
creator: rinlives
